'''jedimaster Training To Train 1.1''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[jedimaster]]
* '''Published:''' 14 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 MWYHL jedimaster LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Due to an overwhelmingly horrible response to version 1. I have made some major changes. Here is version 1.1.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

The following cards are in transit to be put in this deck.

x1 Alter Combo

x1 Leia, RP

x3 Control/Tunnel Vision

x3 Revolution (probably only play 2)

x10 Defensive Shields

x1 Stone Pile

x1 Good Version Of Han (don't know which one yet)

Jedi Test #6 is probably coming out also. ICBW is prob also coming out...or at least a couple of them.

Thanks for the honest comments from the last Version. Hope this suites y'all better.

~JediMaster
